classification: List-price sensitivity arithmetic; not a customer-price, invoice, capacity-pass, or shipment verdict.

monthlyTotalsUsd.formula: activeHours * (computeHourlyUsd + ipv4HourlyUsd) + retainedDiskUsd; excludes network, backup, control-plane, taxes and inference

limitations: This is a list-price scenario, not a measured AWS capacity or UX result.
It excludes data transfer, snapshots, control-plane, backup, taxes and inference.

finding: Both on-demand and spot profiles have preliminary arithmetic totals below 20 USD/month at 60 and 120 active hours (before excluded charges). On-demand is just over 20 at 240 active hours for both shapes; spot remains below 20 at 240 hours. Always-on 730-hour operation exceeds 20 even before excluded charges. No profile is both latency-qualified and fully cost-qualified yet: the 4 GiB profile fails D075 and the 8 GiB profile is unmeasured.
correction: Earlier wording over-restricted the preliminary sub-20 result to spot; the stored on-demand 60/120-hour rows also fall below 20 before unknown charges.
